capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer, state the reason for the outbound call, and ask for an identity verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Initiate the conversation by stating the context of the expiring plan and requesting a verification factor before discussing account details.
steps.text: Hello, MSN-1009 account holder கூட பேசுறேனா? உங்க plan validity முடிய போகுது. Proceed பண்ண, உங்க registered name confirm பண்ணுங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify the identity of the person on the line before disclosing sensitive account details.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor and express severe time pressure.
steps.text: நான் Karthik பேசுறேன். எனக்கு time இல்ல, meeting start ஆக போகுது. என்ன விஷயம்?

steps.model_visible_text: நான் Karthik பேசுறேன். எனக்கு time இல்ல, meeting start ஆக போகுது. என்ன விஷயம்?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
Retrieve the subscriber's current plan, balance, and validity before recommending a recharge.
Return the subscriber's current account state.
State the current balance and validity, and offer to recharge the existing plan.
steps.expected_behavior: Read the balance and validity from the lookup result before suggesting a recharge, complying with BR_TEL_04.
steps.text: Thanks Karthik. உங்க current plan P199 validity 1 day-ல முடியுது. Balance 5 rupees இருக்கு. Same plan recharge பண்ணட்டுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Business rules dictate that the agent must state the current balance and validity before recommending any recharge.

steps.purpose: Reject the current plan, request a 2GB data plan, and urge the agent to be fast.
steps.text: இல்ல, எனக்கு extra data வேணும். 2GB plan இருக்கா? சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.
steps.clean_text: இல்ல, எனக்கு extra data வேணும். 2GB plan இருக்கா? சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Search the catalogue for a plan with at least 2GB of data.
Return available plans meeting the 2GB criteria.
Quote the price and validity of the 2GB plan retrieved from the catalogue.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா, 2GB data வேணும்னா P299 plan இருக்கு. இதோட விலை 299 rupees, validity 28 நாட்கள் வரும்.

steps.purpose: Express that the price is too high and ask for a 1.5GB alternative quickly.
steps.text: 299 அதிகம். 1.5GB plan இருக்கா? விலை மட்டும் சொல்லுங்க, நான் கிளம்பணும்.

steps.purpose: Search the catalogue for a 1.5GB plan as requested.
Return available plans meeting the 1.5GB criteria.
Quote the details of the 1.5GB plan.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா, உங்களுக்காக P249 plan இருக்கு. இதுல 1.5GB data கிடைக்கும், இதோட விலை 249 rupees.

steps.purpose: Approve the recharge for the 1.5GB plan.
Execute the recharge for the selected plan.
Return the outcome of the recharge transaction.
Confirm the successful recharge, state the transaction ID, and note that it is effective immediately.
steps.text: உங்க recharge பண்ணியாச்சு. Transaction ID TXN-889. இந்த plan immediate ஆக வேலை செய்யும். ரொம்ப நன்றி.

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses in tool outputs for the balance, plan details, and transaction status in later turns, successfully testing the grounding capability, although it fails this requirement in the opening turn.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e1, the agent states that the plan validity ends tomorrow ('நாளை முடியுது') before calling `lookup_subscriber` to retrieve the account state. This violates the strict Tool Output Grounding requirement that all statuses and numbers must appear in a preceding tool result.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify e1 to state generally that the plan is expiring soon (e.g., 'உங்க plan validity முடிய போகுது') without specifying the exact timeframe, as the exact validity days left have not yet been retrieved.

verification.summary: The conversation generally follows the workflow, captures the time-pressured persona well, and maintains excellent script fidelity. However, the agent hallucinates the exact plan expiry timeframe in the opening turn before performing the necessary account lookup, violating the strict Tool Output Grounding variant.

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently uses Tamil script for Tamil lexis and Roman script for English lexis and domain terms (e.g., 'plan validity', 'Proceed', 'registered name', 'current plan', 'Balance', 'recharge', 'Transaction ID'), strictly following the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH requirement.
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Language-Script Fidelity > SCRIPT_FIDELITY

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds all quantitative details, statuses, and identifiers in the preceding tool outputs. For example, in e7, the agent quotes the plan P199, 1 day validity, and 5 rupees balance from e6. In e11 and e15, plan prices and data limits are taken directly from e10 and e14. In e19, the transaction ID and 'immediate' effective status are drawn from e18.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation accurately reflects the outbound plan expiry scenario with a time-pressured persona. The agent properly verifies the customer's identity, retrieves the account state before suggesting a recharge, and searches the catalogue according to the customer's changing data requirements. The STT error is phonetically plausible, and the language/script constraints are meticulously followed. Tool use and grounding are correct throughout.
